route_title: UV-Blocking Quarter-Wave Stack with Thickness Optimization for SWIR Transmission
compilation_rationale: Compiled 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica with fixed material order. Optimizes thicknesses [20, 200] nm to jointly maximize mean reflectance in 300–450 nm and mean transmittance in 1000–1700 nm at normal incidence. Uses coherent TMM with dual-band equal-weight scoring. Physics constraints and bounds applied per policy.
